meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configures a language server so editor/agent tooling (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) works. Use when a project needs an LSP installed or wired, or a 'no LSP server configured' error appears.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置语言服务器，让编辑器自动提供代码检查与跳转功能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码时遇到未配置语言服务器的提示，导致编辑器没有代码检查与跳转。
copy.tagline_en: Configure a language server to enable code diagnostics and navigation in your editor.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your editor keeps saying no language server is configured when you code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会识别项目里的语言,安装对应的语言服务器,写好配置文件,再跑一次真实的诊断往返来验证,让诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、符号、重命名这些 LSP 工具真正能用。
howto.when: 当项目需要安装或接入语言服务器,或出现「no LSP server configured」这类报错时触发;它先按文件扩展名判断语言,再读对应参考文档。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目配好 LSP,先用 detect-lsp 看看缺什么
say.note: 会扫描目录并列出各语言服务器状态

say.text: 这个文件报错说没有语言服务器,帮我装上再验证一下
say.note: 装完后跑 verify-lsp 做真实诊断往返

say.text: 把这个项目的 TypeScript 语言服务器接好
say.note: 会读 typescript 参考并写入配置

howto.what_en: After install, Claude identifies the languages in a project, installs the matching language server, writes the config, then verifies with a real diagnostics roundtrip so diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, symbols and rename work.
howto.when_en: Use when a project needs an LSP server installed or wired up, or when a 'no LSP server configured' error appears; it first gates on the file extension, then reads the matching reference.

say_en.text: Set up LSP for this project, run detect-lsp first to see what's missing
say_en.note: Scans the dir and reports each server's status

say_en.text: This file says no language server is configured, install and verify it
say_en.note: Runs verify-lsp for a real diagnostics roundtrip

say_en.text: Wire up the TypeScript language server for this project
say_en.note: Reads the typescript reference and writes config
